title: Locked Doors
story: Three locked permission doors inside `~/doors/` and a root-owned vault at `/opt/vault/flag.txt` stand between you and the flag.
description:
1. Door 1: `~/doors/door1.txt` cannot be read (`Permission denied`). Fix its permissions so you can read it.
2. Door 2: `~/doors/unlock.sh` refuses to execute. Make it executable and run it.
3. Door 3: Set `~/doors/door3.key` permissions to **exactly** `640` (`rw-r-----`).
4. The Vault: Discover which command you are permitted to run as `root`, read `/opt/vault/flag.txt`, save the `VAULT_SECRET=...` line into `~/doors/vault.txt`, and run `quest check`.
hints: Inspect the current permissions on all files inside `~/doors` first.
Grant owner read permission on `door1.txt`, add execute permission on `unlock.sh` and run it, and set octal `640` on `door3.key`.
List your allowed `sudo` privileges, run the permitted command to read `/opt/vault/flag.txt`, save the `VAULT_SECRET=...` value into `~/doors/vault.txt`, and run `quest check`.
